WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT s.healtheval, COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref) AS site_count
  FROM scanconservation AS c
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref
  GROUP BY s.healtheval
), shares AS (
  SELECT healtheval, site_count,
         CAST(site_count AS REAL) / SUM(site_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM status_counts
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT AVG(sh.site_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(sh.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(sh.share - o.avg_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM shares AS sh
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE sh.share > o.avg_share;

assumptions.assumption: Missing health and safety statuses are grouped together as NULL; the requested average share is the unweighted average across status groups.
